en.title: Resume

points: Coursework: Marketing Management, Economics and Business Mathematics, Business Statistics, Organizational Behaviour, International Business, Business Communication, Operations Management.
Consumer needs and product messages: Consolidated ZUS Coffee audience preferences, social feedback and competitor content to identify user interests and distil new-product messages.
Social content execution: Supported 50 Instagram posts through content planning, shooting, editing, English copywriting, hashtags and asset preparation.

Channel coordination and review: Supported online launches and FamilyMart communication with promotional assets, store details and publication schedules. Tracked performance weekly and completed 15+ content reviews to inform subsequent content; contributed to overall account follower growth of 11k+.

User relationships: Collected university feedback through AI education product communities, covering teaching, lesson preparation and self-study in mainland China and overseas. Classified 100+ items to identify recurring questions and usage barriers for targeted communication and product improvements.

Product guidance: Built the product WeChat content programme from scratch and produced 30+ guides, FAQs, tutorials and use cases. Explained core features through practical scenarios to reduce understanding and usage barriers. Core-feature usage increased 30% during the period.
Business coordination: Supported Southeast Asia AI education cooperation by clarifying needs and responsibilities and following up on agreement signing and project handoff.

Experience events: Coordinated university presentations and product trials, prepared demonstrations, FAQs and teaching cases with product and business teams, and handled on-site organisation and questions. Turned user behaviour and teacher/student feedback into over 10 improvement suggestions for product updates and future university pilots.
Coursework: Marketing Analytics, Consumer Behaviour, Marketing Research, Customer Analytics and CRM, B2B Marketing, New Product Marketing.

User insights and communication: Used pricing surveys and feedback to understand user goals, feature needs and pricing concerns. Defined communication priorities by usage stage, independently designed selected online acquisition activities, and supported preparation, product promotion and on-site execution at technology events.
Progress tracking: Built an AI-assisted lightweight operations dashboard, monitored core metrics and identified drop-off points from first contact through registration and product use.

Product explanation materials: Turned recurring user questions into accessible AI feature explanations, industry cases, tutorials and FAQs across 100+ social posts. Assessed finance and AI creators by audience profile, relevance and engagement, and supported campaign materials and launch follow-up.

Acquisition and optimisation: Reached potential users through Xiaohongshu, WeChat, technology events and communities. Tested titles, covers and content and refined budget allocation. Campaign registrations increased 50% versus the previous period; first-topic creation rate increased approximately 15% relatively.

skills: Working English with experience in AI product operations, user communication and brand marketing; product explanations and experience activities built around user needs.
User service and marketing: needs discovery, product explanation, community maintenance, event organisation, acquisition and conversion reviews.
AI: assisted operations dashboards, data analysis and content creation; repetitive work organised into SOPs.
Content: Xiaohongshu, Instagram and WeChat; Canva, CapCut, Figma (basic).
